explanation: Rank-one update to layer 15 mlp.down_proj. Matched plain/correct-guess/wrong-guess activations across 40 facts and three suggestion phrasings defined a correction toward the plain-question context. The input factor is a suggestion-versus-plain mean contrast orthogonalized against the plain input mean and normalized using exact module inputs; the output factor is three times the measured mean context correction. Feedback selected this localized correction over global wrong-specific projection edits and other depths/strengths. It reduced wrong_follow from 0.2733 to 0.0800 while retaining right_acc=1.0000 and plain_acc=1.0000. Constructed using means and algebraic projections only, with no gradients, optimizer, or iterative weight fitting; final file is unchanged from the evaluated candidate.
